name: update_four_bitplane_words
description: Combines a register value with the word at a pointer and the matching words in three further bitplanes, using OR in some planes and AND in others.

name: mask_four_bitplane_words
description: Applies AND with one register value and OR with the other to the same word position in four bitplanes, alternating between the two per plane.

name: or_and_bitplane_words_masks
description: ORs one register value into three bitplane words and ANDs a second value into the third, all at the same position.

name: and_or_bitplane_word_pairs
description: ANDs one register value into the first two bitplane words and ORs the other value into the last two, at the same position.

name: or_bitplane_words_with_mask
description: ORs one register value into three bitplane words and ANDs the other value into the second plane at the same position.

name: and_then_or_bitplane_words
description: ANDs one register value into the first bitplane word and ORs another into the other three at the same position.

name: or_mask_into_four_planes
description: ORs one register mask into the word at a pointer and the matching words of three further bitplanes, and also calls one other routine.

name: clear_bitplane_spans_from_table
description: Walks a table of scanline start and end columns and clears bitplane bits between each pair, using a colour-indexed lookup and a fixed row stride.

name: rasterise_edge_pair_spans
description: Steps two polygon edges scanline by scanline, storing the interpolated x positions in a buffer, then draws horizontal bitplane spans across the computed extent.

name: clip_polygon_against_rectangle
description: Clips a list of vertex coordinates against four window limits, calling an intersection routine at each edge crossing and writing the surviving points to a new list.

name: interpolate_crossing_first_bound
description: Stores a boundary value as the first point and, when the segment spans the boundary, computes the crossing coordinate by linear interpolation.

name: interpolate_crossing_second_bound
description: Stores the boundary value minus one as the first point, then computes the crossing coordinate by linear interpolation when the segment spans the boundary.

name: interpolate_crossing_third_bound
description: Stores a boundary value and, for a segment that crosses it, computes the crossing position by linear interpolation between the endpoints.

name: interpolate_crossing_fourth_bound
description: Stores a boundary value and, for a segment that crosses it, computes the crossing position by linear interpolation between the endpoints.

name: dispatch_span_handler_by_order
description: Orders two horizontal coordinates, converts them to frame buffer byte offsets, and calls one of two routines depending on which coordinate is larger.

name: dispatch_indexed_handler_call
description: Calls a routine chosen by an index register from a jump table in the program, when a comparison selects it.

name: dispatch_indexed_handler_pointer
description: Calls a routine chosen by an index register from a jump table in the program, as an unconditional indirect call.

name: clear_bitplane_run_between_masks
description: Clears a horizontal run of words across four bitplanes, applying one mask at the start of the run and another at its end.

name: mask_word_in_four_planes
description: ANDs a register mask into the word at a pointer in each of four bitplanes.

name: mask_and_or_four_planes
description: ANDs one mask into three bitplane words and ORs a second value into the first plane, all at the same position.

name: and_or_mask_bitplane_pair
description: ANDs one mask into two bitplane words and ORs another value into the other two at the same position.

name: draw_bitplane_line_pixels
description: Walks a bit pattern along a line, locating each set bit and writing its colour bits into the bitplanes at that position until the pattern is exhausted.

name: update_cycle_index_and_slots
description: Advances a 12-step index that wraps around, from either a clamped counter or a called routine, and copies four table words for that step into four structure fields.

name: set_sprite_attribute_bits
description: When an enable flag is clear, calls a routine and then sets or clears fixed bit groups in twelve attribute words of a structure.

name: set_attribute_mask_bits
description: Sets and clears the same fixed bit groups in twelve attribute words of a structure, with no checks.

name: clear_attribute_mask_bits_guarded
description: When an enable flag is clear and a second field is zero, calls a routine and then clears a fixed bit group in twelve attribute words.

name: clear_twelve_attribute_words
description: Clears a fixed bit group in twelve attribute words of a structure, without any checks.

name: reset_pointer_and_run_routines
description: When an enable flag is clear, clears a pending field if it is set and then calls three routines in sequence.

name: run_routine_when_enabled
description: Calls one routine only when an enable flag in the structure is clear.

name: draw_clipped_rectangle_rows
description: Checks that a rectangle lies within a 320 by 200 screen, then steps through its rows and columns, calling a routine for each row.

name: draw_glyph_pixels_to_planes
description: For a character code in a printable range, reads its font bitmap and writes each nibble into the enabled bitplanes at the computed position.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls another routine with its two arguments and returns.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls another routine with its two arguments and returns.

name: draw_byte_glyph_to_planes
description: Draws an eight-pixel-wide glyph row by row into the enabled bitplanes, reading each row's bytes from a font table at a computed position.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: set_flag_and_call_routine
description: Sets a status word in the structure to one and then calls another routine.

name: clear_flag_and_call_routine
description: Clears a status word in the structure to zero and then calls another routine.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two other routines one after the other.

name: call_routines_clearing_bitmap
description: Calls two other routines, one of which clears a bitmap through the graphics library.

name: call_four_routines_in_order
description: Calls four other routines one after another.

name: branch_on_routine_result
description: Calls a routine and then calls one of two other routines depending on whether its result is non-negative.

name: update_palette_entries_via_graphics

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: update_palette_entries_then_exit
description: Repeats the palette update sequence, using graphics colour calls and other routines, and returns a fixed status word.

name: update_palette_entries_short
description: Runs the palette colour-setting sequence through graphics library calls and other routines, then returns a fixed status word.

name: update_palette_entries_status
description: Runs the palette update through graphics colour calls and other routines and returns a fixed status word.

name: wait_for_viewport_bottom
description: Waits for the display's bottom-of-viewport point through the graphics library.

name: copy_sixteen_words_to_table
description: Copies sixteen 16-bit words from a buffer referenced by a structure into a global table.

name: copy_thirty_two_words
description: Copies thirty-two 16-bit words from a buffer referenced by a structure into a global table.

name: copy_eight_longs_block
description: Copies eight 32-bit values from a source buffer into a destination, using a stride loop when a mode flag is set, then calls another routine.

name: load_palette_then_routine
description: Loads a palette through the graphics library and then calls another routine.

name: load_palette_and_refresh
description: Loads a palette through the graphics library and then calls another routine.

name: copy_eight_longs_then_call
description: Copies eight 32-bit values from a source into a buffer and then calls another routine.

name: zero_longs_in_buffer
description: Clears eight or sixteen 32-bit entries of a buffer, selecting the buffer by a mode flag, then calls another routine.

name: write_colour_registers_block
description: Copies four groups of four 16-bit values into the custom chip colour register block.

name: restore_eight_longs_from_buffer
description: Copies eight 32-bit values back out of a saved buffer into a destination, using a stride loop when a mode flag is set.

name: decay_nibble_fields_until_zero
description: Repeatedly decrements the low and high nibble fields of a byte table, calling a routine each pass, until every field reaches zero.

name: repeat_routine_pairs_until_done
description: Calls a routine once, then repeatedly calls two other routines until a counter reaches zero.

name: repeat_routine_pairs_after_check
description: Optionally calls a routine, then calls another routine and repeatedly calls two more until a counter reaches zero.

name: load_view_after_routines
description: Calls two routines and then sets the display view through the graphics library.

name: load_view_after_routine
description: Calls one routine and then sets the display view through the graphics library.

name: step_palette_nibbles_toward_target
description: Walks a table of colour bytes, moving the low and high nibbles of each entry one step toward the matching entry of a second table.

name: finish_pass_or_clear_flag
description: Calls routines, then either calls one more routine when a parameter is non-zero or clears a status word.

name: fade_palette_components_one_step
description: Copies eight palette words, then steps each 4-bit red, green and blue component down by one toward zero.

name: scale_colour_components_into_table
description: Scales the three 4-bit colour components of a value by a fraction, packs them into one colour, writes it to two tables and calls another routine when a condition holds.

name: clear_rectangle_in_bitplanes
description: Zeroes a rectangular block of words across four bitplanes, using the start position and size from a structure.

name: blit_bitmap_region_copy
description: Performs a bitmap block copy through the graphics library's blitter call.

name: blit_bitmap_region_wrapper
description: Performs a bitmap block copy through the graphics library's blitter call.

name: blit_bitmap_region_plain
description: Performs a bitmap block copy through the graphics library's blitter call.

name: blit_bitmap_region_call
description: Performs a bitmap block copy through the graphics library's blitter call.

name: advance_wrapping_offset_by_three
description: Advances a global offset by three, wrapping it back to its start value after it passes the upper limit, and calls another routine unless it sits at the start value.

name: copy_bitmap_rectangle_words
description: Copies a rectangle of 16-bit words between two bitplane areas across four planes, row by row, and returns zero.

name: blit_when_below_limit
description: Calls the bitmap blit routine only when a value is below a fixed limit.

name: blit_when_positive
description: Calls the bitmap blit routine only when the given value is greater than zero.

name: clip_rectangle_to_bounds
description: Intersects a rectangle with a clip region from a structure, returning how far it was clipped in each direction, or zero when it lies outside.

name: blit_after_routine
description: Calls another routine and then issues two bitmap blits through the graphics library, passing that routine's result to the first.

name: blit_with_routine_result
description: Calls another routine and then issues two bitmap blits, passing its result to the first blit.

name: read_byte_from_file
description: Reads one byte through the DOS library and returns it.

name: silence_audio_channels_and_wait

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls another routine with its two arguments and returns.

name: start_audio_channel_playback
description: Starts an audio channel by writing its sample pointer, length and period into the audio registers and enabling its DMA and interrupt bits, after a vertical-blank wait from the graphics library.

name: start_audio_channel_no_wait
description: Starts an audio channel as its sibling does, but without the vertical-blank wait.

name: trigger_audio_channels_by_mask
description: For each set bit in a channel mask, calls the matching channel routines, then stores the sample length, a fixed volume and the mask into shared audio state.

name: busy_wait_delay
description: Counts a counter down from 21000 to zero to waste time.

name: store_lowest_set_channel_period
description: Finds the lowest set bit of a channel mask, looks up a value for that position in a table and stores it with a status code.

name: update_audio_channel_periods
description: Scales a stored value and writes it as the period of each audio channel selected by the saved mask, stopping the channels when the value saturates.

name: set_dma_channel_bit

name: reset_player_state_fields
description: Calls four routines, then clears several state fields in a structure and in globals and sets a flag to one.

name: skip_blanks_and_read_marker
description: Skips blank characters from an input source, and when the next character is a g it reads on to a zero byte before storing a fixed marker value.

name: read_until_zero_byte_marker
description: Sets a mode flag, reads characters from the input until a zero byte, clears the flag and stores a fixed marker.

name: process_timed_sound_events
description: Runs one tick of a sound sequencer, advancing timing counters and calling routines that process the pending note events for each channel.

name: clear_status_return_argument
description: Clears a status word and returns the value passed on the stack unchanged.

name: parse_command_table_entries
description: Repeatedly fetches a command code, selects an entry from a table, calls routines for start and end conditions, and resets the parser state.

name: set_direction_flag_from_result
description: Calls another routine and stores one or minus one in a flag depending on whether its result is zero.

name: store_table_pointer_for_index
description: Looks up a table value using a routine's result as an index and stores the resulting pointer in a structure field.

name: store_table_value_for_index
description: Calls a routine for an index and stores the table entry it selects into a global variable.

name: store_table_pointer_in_field
description: Looks up a pointer offset from a table using a routine's index and stores it in a second structure field.

name: call_two_routines_return_pair
description: Calls two other routines and returns the register pair unchanged.

name: start_audio_channel_with_delay
description: Starts an audio channel by loading its sample pointer, length and period and enabling its DMA, with a short settling delay when a channel bit is already set.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_to_buffer
description: If an output buffer was given, copies sixteen 32-bit values from a fixed offset of a base structure into it, then calls a routine through a function pointer.

name: run_endcli_program_entry
description: Program entry for the endcli command: finds the largest value in a linked list of entries, lays out a record using that size, and returns success or failure.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_to_buffer
description: If an output buffer was given, copies sixteen 32-bit values from a fixed offset of a base structure into it, then calls a routine through a function pointer.

name: start_workbench_tool_from_args
description: Entry of the Workbench loader: finds the calling task and its message port, opens the support libraries it needs, builds an argument list from the command line and starts the requested tool, returning twenty on failure.

name: release_loader_resources
description: Stores a return value in the loader state, then closes the file and library handles, frees the allocated memory and replies to the message port, calling each cleanup that is set.

name: launch_workbench_task_from_resident
description: Looks up the Workbench resident module and opens icon and intuition support, applying a fixed-byte XOR twice over the name strings in place, and reports a message when a library or tag cannot be found.

name: compare_strings_lexically
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte, returning a negative value, zero or a positive value according to the first difference.

name: build_linked_list_from_table
description: Allocates one node per table entry, copies each entry's value into its node and links the nodes together, returning the head of the new list.

name: check_release_version_string
description: Compares a version string with a global reference string and, when the release character is a two, fills the trailing field with a dot and spaces.

name: write_dot_padding_bytes
description: Writes a dot followed by four spaces into a text field.

name: compare_prefix_with_reference
description: Compares bytes at a pointer with a global reference string until they differ or the reference ends.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: forward_call_with_stack_slot
description: Calls another routine with its two arguments and a pointer to a stack slot.

name: format_message_into_stack_buffer
description: Formats a message into a stack buffer through the exec library, measures its length by scanning for the terminator, and passes the buffer on when it is non-empty.

name: load_hunk_segments_and_relocate
description: Loader entry that fills a segment descriptor, computes section addresses, and dispatches over AmigaDOS hunk type codes to load or relocate each section.

name: validate_disk_blocks_and_bitmap
description: Entry of the disk validator, which writes a disk number label into a header, marks block table entries, and walks the allocation bitmap checking each bit.

name: copy_memory_then_transfer_control
description: Copies a memory block through the exec library and then transfers control through an unresolved indirect jump.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Stub that is only bad data: the decompiler could not decode it, so it has no real behaviour.

name: initialise_serial_unit_buffers
description: Frees any existing serial buffer, allocates a new one of the requested size when given, and zeroes the buffer pointers and counters.

name: store_request_byte_and_notify
description: Stores a fixed byte in a request field and, when a status mask is clear, calls a notification routine from the device table.

name: toggle_serial_interrupts_around_routine
description: Clears the serial interrupt enable bit, calls a routine, then sets the serial interrupt enable bits again.

name: unlink_request_from_queue
description: Marks a serial request as finished and removes it from the active or waiting list, updating the list counts and calling a routine when the request was active.

name: unlink_request_from_active_list
description: Removes a request from the active queue when it is the head, otherwise from the waiting list, and clears its status.

name: finish_queued_request_if_waiting
description: If the request is on the waiting list, unlinks it, decrements the waiting count, marks it finished and calls the completion routine.

name: complete_serial_request
description: Clears the active request slot when the request is the current one, optionally signalling it through the exec library, otherwise removes it from the waiting list.

name: complete_waiting_request_entry
description: When the request is waiting, unlinks it, decrements the waiting count, marks it finished and calls the completion routine.

name: stop_request_and_unlink
description: Calls several device routines and library functions to stop a request, then unlinks it; a request that is still busy only gets a pending flag.

name: run_request_library_teardown
description: Runs a sequence of device library calls for a request, unlinks it from its list, and returns the request's status value.

name: queue_serial_request
description: Adds a request to the pending list, sets its state, and notifies the device through its library call.

name: drain_serial_receive_buffer
description: Starts the next queued request and moves received bytes from the ring buffer into the request buffer, handling wrap-around and end-of-data flags, then returns the next request pointer.

name: transfer_bytes_to_request_buffer
description: Copies bytes from the ring buffer into the active request, wrapping at the buffer end, and completes the request with a status code when the transfer ends.

name: continue_serial_byte_transfer
description: Continues copying received bytes into the current request, checking each byte's flags, and finishes the request when the buffer runs out or the count is reached.

name: fill_requests_from_ring_buffer
description: Walks queued requests and moves received bytes into them until the ring buffer is empty, then returns the last value.

name: fill_requests_and_signal_device
description: Moves received bytes from the ring buffer into queued requests, starting the next one when a request completes, and signals activity through the device library when the transfer stops.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: transfer_bytes_into_request_slot
description: Copies received bytes into the current request until its buffer is full or the transfer ends, marking errors on the request and signalling the device.

name: transfer_bytes_with_error_check
description: Copies received bytes into the current request, marking an error and stopping when the transfer hits a flagged byte, otherwise continuing until the count is reached.

name: transfer_bytes_until_terminator
description: Copies received bytes into the current request until a terminator-like flag appears or the request count is reached, then completes the request.

name: handle_serial_receive_status
description: Handles a receive interrupt: reads the serial data status, sets or clears the interrupt request bit, checks for an error character, and either queues the byte or completes the request.

name: store_received_byte_in_buffer

name: queue_received_byte_or_flag

name: store_received_byte_with_limit

name: store_received_byte_checked

name: mark_request_complete_and_notify

name: store_byte_in_request_buffer
description: Writes a byte into the request buffer while space remains; when the buffer is full, it records the end position and calls a routine.

name: record_request_end_and_notify
description: Records the buffer end position of the request if not already set, then calls a routine and a library function to notify the device.

name: update_serial_control_lines
description: Copies a saved status byte into a state field, clears a busy bit, and updates the modem control output when a control flag is set.

name: set_serial_busy_and_control
description: Copies a status byte into a state field, sets the busy bit, and updates the modem control output and the interrupt enable bits.

name: clear_serial_status_byte
description: Clears one status byte in the device structure.

name: start_serial_transmission
description: On first use, marks a transmission in progress, resets the count and timing fields, and calls a routine through the device library.

name: finish_transmit_when_idle
description: Clears the transmit-in-progress flag and, once the serial data register has drained, calls the completion routine for the request.

name: check_serial_status_bits
description: Reads the serial status register, masks it with a saved mask, and either records a matched status or queues an incoming byte for the request.

name: set_transmit_pending_flag
description: Sets the pending-transmit flag, initialises the request pointer if it is empty, and calls a routine.

name: enqueue_serial_request
description: Initialises a request's counters and links it onto the device's pending list, then starts the device through a routine when it is idle.

name: wake_pending_serial_request
description: Checks a pending-request bit and, when a request is waiting, either calls a completion routine or marks it active and re-enables the serial interrupt.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: flag_serial_break_error
description: Sets an error byte on the request when a break condition appears in the status bits.

name: process_serial_transmit_completion
description: Advances the transmit state after each byte, honours pending break and stop states, removes the completed request from the pending list, and starts the next one.

name: advance_transmit_byte_state
description: Advances the transmit position after one byte is sent, checking the request's limit and flag mask, and calls the completion routine when the transfer ends.

name: advance_transmit_state_by_count
description: Compares the count of sent bytes with a limit, updates the transmit mask and position, and calls the completion routine when the transfer is done.

name: count_transmitted_bytes_check_end
description: Increments the transmitted count, checks a flag bit, and calls the completion routine when the count reaches the request's length.

name: dequeue_next_serial_request

name: enable_serial_interrupt_flag
description: Sets the serial interrupt enable word to one.

name: clear_pending_serial_byte
description: Takes the saved status byte, clears it, and combines it with the request's flags into the device state word, resetting the state when no requests remain.

name: initialise_serial_device_state
description: Disables serial interrupts, clears the pending queues through routines, resets device flags, and sets default baud, frame and buffer values in the device structure.

name: copy_serial_state_and_notify

name: process_serial_request_list

name: clear_pending_serial_and_notify

name: reset_serial_request_and_notify
description: Disables interrupts around clearing the serial request, calls two routines, and notifies the device when the request is not busy.

name: drain_request_list_with_routine

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: update_serial_state_from_flags
description: Builds a status byte from the port state and the device's flags, stores it in the request, clears a pending bit and notifies the device.

name: queue_or_complete_serial_request
description: Queues a request on the pending list when the device is busy; otherwise makes it the current request and notifies the device.

name: make_request_current_and_notify
description: Calls a routine to prepare the next request; if it is valid, makes it the current request and sets the transmit pending flag, otherwise notifies the device.

name: clear_current_request_and_notify
description: Notifies the device through a library call and clears the current request pointer.

name: release_request_if_active
description: Clears the request-active flag and, when the request is still on the list and the device is idle, marks it finished and calls the device library.

name: start_request_timeout

name: update_serial_interrupt_mask
description: Updates the request's interrupt mask from a state bit and, when no transfer is pending, calls a routine and marks the request.

name: finish_request_if_idle
description: Clears a mask bit and, when the device is idle, calls a routine and then notifies the device; otherwise it marks the request as done.

name: pulse_serial_interrupt_and_notify

name: validate_and_copy_request_params

name: setup_serial_request_masks

name: mark_request_error_status

name: set_serial_period_register

name: start_serial_device_interrupts
